subject: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed

Team,

Summary: Lumera (Series B, healthcare SaaS) is requesting a one-way opt-out from our standard 12‑month ramp staircase tied to committed spend. They want the ability to terminate early with a partial credit schedule if usage falls below the lower threshold within the first 6 months. They have signaled at‑risk need for a budget reprioritization if they don't see adoption by month 3.

Ask: Exec approval to accept a modified early-termination / downsell protection with the following non-standard terms:
- Early termination allowed within first 6 months with graduated repayment: 75% credit if terminated month 1, 50% month 2–3, 25% month 4–6.
- Ramp opt-out clause allowing Lumera to reduce committed capacity by up to 30% once (irrevocable) if monthly usage < 35% of committed capacity for two consecutive months.
- Standard SLA & data protections remain; contract redline attached.

Commercial impact: Expected ARR at commit is $420k. Worst case (opt-out + early terminate at month 1) reduces short-term billings by ~55k; modeled scenarios in attachment. Upside: close probability moves from 48% -> 82% with this concession (per HS notes).

Risk mitigations proposed:
- Attach a mandatory QBR cadence during first 6 months with product adoption milestones and success playbook.
- Automatic conversion to pay-as-you-go (no discounts) after ramp opt-out or termination window.
- Limit opt-out to once, per-contract; no re-entry.

Attachments: Lumera_Amendment_proposed.pdf (proposed amendment text), Lumera_contract_redline.docx (redline), impact_modeling_Sept2025.xlsx

Background: Sam Park (VP Ops) asked for flexibility to get procurement over the line — they are leaning heavily on cash runway. Legal (cc'd external) has asked for a template.

Decision requested: Approve the above concession as-is / approve with changes / deny and provide alternate guidance.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment (stub): Lumera_Amendment_proposed.pdf (12 pages, proposed language)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick thoughts:

1) I support the one-time 30% opt-out but would prefer the opt-out be exercisable only after month 3 (not month 1–2) to protect initial onboarding investments. Can we move that milestone?
2) The graduated repayment schedule looks reasonable if we keep the higher credit at month 1 (75%) but add a clause that any early termination is subject to a final adoption review by Customer Success and Finance before credit is applied.
3) We should add a minimum notice period (30 days) to the opt-out activation.

Can you ask Legal to produce a redline that enforces notice + CS/Finance sign-off? If Legal agrees, I can greenlight commercially. Vivek — can you weigh in for final approval if Legal signs off?

-Karthik
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 10:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed

Mina / Karthik — finance review notes attached in the model. Key items:
- If opt-out is exercisable before month 3 we see material revenue recognition risk and higher churn allowance; prefer opt-out earliest at month 4.
- The repayment schedule needs clearer wording about whether credits offset future invoices or are refunded. We recommend credits as invoice offsets only (no cash refunds).
- Please add explicit metric triggers (e.g., <35% committed usage AND <3 critical feature activations) rather than purely % usage, so we have objective gating.

If Legal accepts invoice-offsets-only and we add CS/Finance sign-off and a 30-day notice, finance can support. I've flagged the ARR impact in the model tab 'concessions'.

-Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment (stub): impact_modeling_Sept2025.xlsx (key tabs: scenarios, sensitivity, notes)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed

Team — I reviewed the ask and the mitigations. I will approve the concession with the following mandatory changes before legal signs:
1) Move earliest opt-out exercisable date to after month 3 (i.e., month 4–6 window only).
2) Add 30-day notice requirement for opt-out and require a documented QBR within 14 days of notice.
3) Credits are invoice offsets only (no cash refunds).
4) CS + Finance sign-off required prior to credit application.

If Legal can incorporate the above into the redline, I authorize commercial acceptance. Two reasons: this materially increases close likelihood and keeps our downside protected by process gates.

Vivek
Chief Commercial Officer
Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Lumera Therapeutics early-termination opt-out & graduated ramp — exec approval needed

Sam — following internal review, Redwood can accept a ramp opt-out and graduated early-termination schedule on a conditional basis. Required contract language updates (summary):
- Opt-out window limited to months 4–6 only; opt-out may be exercised once and requires 30 days' notice.
- Early-termination credit schedule remains but credits will be applied as invoice offsets only per Finance.
- Opt-out or early termination requires documented CS + Finance sign-off; QBR scheduled within 14 days of notice.
- We will also add explicit metric triggers for opt-out: both (a) sustained monthly usage < 35% of committed capacity for two consecutive months AND (b) fewer than 3 product success milestones completed.

Next steps: I've asked Legal (external) to review and produce a redline. I've uploaded the redline to HubSpot and started a DocuSign envelope for the amendment (link below). If Legal accepts the redline, we will proceed to signature today.

DocuSign (started): https://www.docusign.net/ABC123-LUMERA
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/record/HB-2025-0897

Thanks everyone for quick turn.
Mina
Account Executive, Healthcare
Redwood Inference
